### Guardian checklist

- [ ] ViralLab Guardian is green
- [ ] Main mobile flow was considered
- [ ] Existing projects are not deleted or migrated silently
- [ ] Secrets and credentials were not committed
- [ ] Changes involving Drive, authentication, clinical data, or deletion received human review

### Release

After approval and green checks, run **Actions → ViralLab Release Gate → Run workflow** to promote the validated commit to the `production` branch.
